_comment: Eval-runner settings for scripts/eval-runner.js: default models, run budget, and the token heuristics used for cost estimates. Model prices are NOT here: they come from meta/model-prices.json, the one price table shared with /naksha-stats (scripts/lib/pricing.js). A custom --prices file may add its own "models" ({ id: { input, output } } in USD per million tokens) to override them.

estimates._comment: Heuristics used to turn eval specs into token counts. All values here are PLACEHOLDERS (unmeasured assumptions). Replace them with numbers from a real run's usage when you have one.
